title: Blue Lock Mixed Facts
story_context: The cave lock needs fast facts.

printed_instructions: Write answers clearly. Use counters only if you are stuck or the page asks for them.
Optional challenge: solve the first pass without counting objects one by one.
layout_description: Black-and-white printable page themed around Blue Lock Mixed Facts; open writing space, large text, optional small art border, no dense background.
